paragraphs: Knee Osteoarthritis (OA) Detection using Deep Learning is an AI-powered clinical decision support system designed to assist in the early detection and severity assessment of Knee Osteoarthritis from X-ray images. Osteoarthritis is one of the most prevalent degenerative joint disorders worldwide, leading to chronic pain, reduced mobility, and diminished quality of life. Early and accurate diagnosis is essential for timely intervention and improved patient outcomes.

This project leverages deep learning techniques to automatically analyze knee X-ray images and classify disease severity based on the Kellgren-Lawrence (KL) grading system (Grades 0–4). Beyond prediction, the application incorporates Grad-CAM explainability to visualize the regions influencing the model's decisions, thereby enhancing transparency and clinical trust.
The solution is delivered through an intuitive Streamlit-based web application, enabling users to upload X-ray images and instantly receive:
features: Upload knee X-ray images in JPG, JPEG, or PNG format.
Displays confidence percentage for each prediction.
Visual heatmaps highlight the regions influencing model decisions.
Built using Streamlit for easy accessibility.
